title: Keeping a collection that keeps its value
target: How to keep a TCG Card Shop Simulator collection in order so that the cards you display, grade and sell do not get muddled together.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Binder pages to store cards in
Shelves you can see at a glance
Somewhere to send cards for grading

steps.do: Store what you are keeping in binder pages rather than loose.
steps.because: the game has binder pages as their own storage (T_BinderPage_albedo)

steps.do: Keep display stock apart from what is for sale.
steps.because: display slots are tracked separately from ordinary shelf slots (DisplaySlot)

steps.do: Decide what goes for grading before it goes on display.
steps.because: a submission holds your cards while it is away (GradeCardSubmitSet)

steps.do: Check the record when you are unsure what you own.
steps.because: the game keeps a compact list of the cards in a deck and a pool (DeckCompactCardDataList)

steps.do: Put graded cards somewhere they can be seen rather than in a pile.
steps.because: graded cards return in a case with its own artwork (GradedCardCaseBack)

commonMistakes: Mixing the collection with stock that is for sale.
Sending cards for grading that you needed on the shelf.
Leaving graded cards in a pile after they come back.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
